context.period: Wallets active between March and August 2026
context.allocationRule: Every eligible wallet receives an allocation. Excluding a real user costs more than excluding a farmed one saves, so the bar has to be argued for.
context.similarityNote: Each wallet is compared against the population, not against named wallets: the counts say how many wallets share a trait, never which.
context.note: Every address in this file is invented and starts 0xDEMO. No real allocation, protocol or user is represented.
